ablationModels.volatility: har-style log-RV ridge on rich features alpha100

costs.note: 10bp costs plus 2bp slippage per turnover unit, including liquidation; sampled non-overlapping decisions are diagnostic, not executable strategy proof

direction.calibration: temperature scaling fitted on a separate purged 14-day past window, never on validation; compare raw/calibrated proper scores

definitions.binary: up/down conditional on nonzero future log return; zero labels excluded identically for every candidate
definitions.costDiagnostic: Compare neutral shares with round-trip cost 24bp; do not assume directional accuracy covers costs
definitions.neutral: down/neutral/up using origin-known max(1bp, 0.5 * past-60-minute sigma * sqrt(h))

explainability.method: one-day circular feature-group shifts on validation for fixed rich logistic and HAR-style RV models; dependence/correlation caveats
explainability.shap: deferred: no prospective-validated complex candidate; avoid expensive explanations of unproven price signals

protocol.historicalHoldoutPolicy: All supplied history, including the inspected September/October holdout, is development evidence. It is never final confirmation. No new trials are chosen from its results.

selection.productionActivation: never from historical study; requires separately scored frozen future confirmation
selection.uncertainty: paired daily losses; seven-day moving-block bootstrap descriptive 95% intervals, HAC Student-t one-sided Bonferroni evidence across all planned hypotheses including prior phase; approximate dependence assumptions disclosed

volatility.interval: 90% split-conformal absolute log-volatility residual interval fitted on past calibration data; report actual validation coverage, never invent confidence
volatility.target: sum of squared completed one-minute log returns strictly after origin through horizon; displayed sqrt(target), nonannualized horizon log-return standard deviation

resourceAccounting.note: original optional explanation guard checked between model batches; a 15-second admission margin now prevents starting another batch near the cap; no additional model fitting was performed
